system.description:
Reanimation Rite — Feast. 1 Action, Reach: 8. Remove Soul Touched from an undead minion: command all remaining minions to Move 6 and Attack (1d8). On hit: restore 2 HP for each damage die. If Soul Touched wasn’t removed, this does nothing. The consumed minion leaves an exploitable corpse (dissolves after 1 hour).

[A] Using this Rite checks the target for your Soul Touched and removes it (the module warns but lets you proceed if the target isn’t marked).

[M] Move the minions, roll their 1d8 attacks and apply the 2 HP per damage die healing by hand; remove the consumed minion’s token and leave a corpse marker.
